related.title: HP Multi Jet Fusion 製造平台
related.titleEn: HP Multi Jet Fusion manufacturing platform
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付層方向圖、載重撓度圖與斷言適用範圍。；教學 1 N 下撓度≤0.8 mm，1.92 N/mm 方案通過，0.768 N/mm 方案失敗。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver layer orientation, load-deflection plot and applicability statement.; At a teaching 1 N load and ≤0.8 mm deflection, 1.92 N/mm passes and 0.768 N/mm fails.
related.difference: 以外形體積與質量建立相對密度估算，區分孔隙與尺寸誤差。
related.differenceEn: Estimate relative density from envelope volume and mass, separating porosity from dimensional error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: I=bh³/12，端點剛度 k=3EI/L³；方向效應先以等效 E 表示。；教學 E=1500 N/mm²、b=10 mm、h=4 mm、L=50 mm。；I=10×4³/12=53.333 mm⁴；k=3×1500×53.333/50³=1.92 N/mm。
相對密度 ρrel=m/(ρsolid V)，表觀孔隙率估算為 1−ρrel。；教學試片外形 V=10 cm³、質量 9.5 g、假設實體密度 1.0 g/cm³。；孔隙率估算=(1−9.5/(1.0×10))×100=5%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: I=bh³/12 and tip stiffness k=3EI/L³; orientation is represented by effective E.; Teaching E=1500 N/mm², b=10 mm, h=4 mm and L=50 mm.; I=53.333 mm⁴; k=3×1500×53.333/50³=1.92 N/mm.
Relative density is m/(ρsolid V); estimated apparent porosity is 1−ρrel.; Teaching envelope V=10 cm³, mass 9.5 g and assumed solid density 1.0 g/cm³.; Estimated porosity=(1−9.5/(1.0×10))×100=5%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工具機靜壓導軌
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付層方向圖、載重撓度圖與斷言適用範圍。；教學 1 N 下撓度≤0.8 mm，1.92 N/mm 方案通過，0.768 N/mm 方案失敗。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver layer orientation, load-deflection plot and applicability statement.; At a teaching 1 N load and ≤0.8 mm deflection, 1.92 N/mm passes and 0.768 N/mm fails.
related.difference: 將液膜與結構串聯剛度分開，找出只改善液膜的效益上限。
related.differenceEn: Separate fluid-film and structure stiffness in series and find limits to improving the film alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: I=bh³/12，端點剛度 k=3EI/L³；方向效應先以等效 E 表示。；教學 E=1500 N/mm²、b=10 mm、h=4 mm、L=50 mm。；I=10×4³/12=53.333 mm⁴；k=3×1500×53.333/50³=1.92 N/mm。
1/keq=1/kfilm+1/kstructure，總撓度為兩段撓度相加。；教學液膜剛度 50 N/μm、結構 100 N/μm、負載 100 N。；keq=1/(1/50+1/100)=33.3333 N/μm；δ=100/keq=3 μm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: I=bh³/12 and tip stiffness k=3EI/L³; orientation is represented by effective E.; Teaching E=1500 N/mm², b=10 mm, h=4 mm and L=50 mm.; I=53.333 mm⁴; k=3×1500×53.333/50³=1.92 N/mm.
1/keq=1/kfilm+1/kstructure; total deflection sums both contributions.; Teaching film stiffness 50 N/μm, structure stiffness 100 N/μm and load 100 N.; keq=1/(1/50+1/100)=33.3333 N/μm; δ=100/keq=3 μm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
